fdat_tuning_rule: max mean train-fold WGA over sigma0.5/1/2; tie higher composite-clean WGA, higher mean blur AA, smaller lambda, smaller cap. If matched originals unavailable no clean constraint is imputed.
global_tie_rule: mean blur WGA desc, original WGA desc, mean blur AA desc, abs(t-0.5) asc, t asc
transfer_global_original_pool: exclude every held-out species from full-original threshold-fitting data
study_scope: TEST ORACLE / IN-SAMPLE; retrospective species-blocked transfer only; no independent development/final test
